hypothesis_text: When a major altcoin (SOLUSDT) undergoes an extreme idiosyncratic 1-hour return decoupling relative to Bitcoin (|return_1h_btc_neutral| > 0.005), the price displacement reflects transient order imbalance and speculative overextension rather than fundamental repricing. In the subsequent 1h to 4h window, this idiosyncratic shock mean-reverts (predicted_sign = -1). The mean-reversion is reinforced when conditioned on extreme taker aggression (gate_tail on taker_buy_ratio_1h) representing flow exhaustion, or extreme resting order book asymmetry (gate_tail on depth_imbalance_10) providing passive absorption against continuation.
narrative: In cryptocurrency markets, Bitcoin serves as the primary liquidity and systematic risk anchor. Altcoins frequently decouple idiosyncratic over 1-hour windows due to localized taker market orders, liquidations, and retail momentum chasing. When |return_1h_btc_neutral| exceeds 0.005 (top 20% tails of the distribution), price moves ahead of broader market fundamentals. Market makers and arbitrageurs who provided passive liquidity to absorb these aggressive flows face inventory imbalances and subsequently mark prices back toward the BTC-neutral baseline as aggressive flow dissipates. Conditioning with gate_tail on taker_buy_ratio_1h isolates the climax phases where aggressive flow reaches historical tail extremes (|z| > 2), typically signaling the exhaustion of market orders. Simultaneously, gate_tail on depth_imbalance_10 identifies periods where resting book depth is heavily stacked against the direction of the shock, confirming structural absorption capacity that prevents further displacement and enforces mean reversion.
research_rationale: Anchor signal XL_SOLUSDT_30de9d330654 was derived by locking a symmetric two-sided predicate abs(return_1h_btc_neutral) > 0.005 on SOLUSDT. The scan panel reveals robust dispersion: 33,904 matched rows across 409 independent active days with balanced positive (16,743) and negative (17,161) sides, yielding a clean gene_relation basis where positive residual predicts downward forward return (-1). Autocorrelation drops from 0.72 at 1-bar to -0.029 at 1h and -0.012 at 1d, verifying that daily events represent independent cross-sectional shocks rather than persistent trend states. Cemetery analysis for return_1h_btc_neutral shows that 557 of 766 evidential deaths occurred at T0.04-IC-STAT due to unconditioned noise in dense formulas, while taker_buy_ratio_1h with gate_tail yielded the highest survival rate (18.5%, 10 of 54 survived). Our composition plan directly addresses these historical kill codes: gate_tail on taker_buy_ratio_1h (trigger) and gate_tail on depth_imbalance_10 (absorption) restrict trading to sparse, event-driven liquidity exhaustion states, cutting turnover cost and raising signal-to-noise ratio. Probe partner analysis verifies 1.0 coverage and projected event observations exceeding 680 (well above the 250 event floor).
